name: Elena Popescu
bio:
Elena's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. Initially trained as a mechanical engineer, she found herself drawn to the high-stakes, fast-paced world of racing after attending a local rally event. The intricate engineering and the constant push for innovation resonated deeply. She joined ART Grand Prix five years ago and has quickly become a reliable member of the team. 

Elena prides herself on her meticulous approach to fabrication, ensuring every component meets exacting standards. She believes in a collaborative approach, valuing input from engineers and mechanics alike to optimize performance and durability. Her calm demeanor and ability to remain focused under pressure make her an invaluable asset during crucial race preparations. Her ambition drives her to constantly seek improvement and explore new fabrication techniques.

physical.hairStyle: Long, braided and usually tied back in a practical bun.
physical.description: Elena is of average height with a sturdy build, reflecting her hands-on work.

quirks: Always sharpens her pencils to an impossibly fine point before starting a task.
Has a collection of miniature tools she keeps on her workbench as good luck charms.
Drinks copious amounts of strong, black coffee throughout the day.
